description: Use this when the user asks what federal agencies have published, proposed or announced, including a rulemaking, for example "what has the FDA proposed on food dyes?", "find final rules on noncompete agreements" or "which executive orders mention AI this year?". Pass the words to find and optionally the document type (rule, proposed_rule, notice, presidential_document) and a publication date range. Returns each document's title, type, agencies, publication date, abstract, effective date, comment deadline, the CFR parts it changes and a link. This is general information, not legal advice. Do not use it to read the current text of a regulation (use get_cfr_section), or for state law, bills, court decisions or non-US rules.

documentType.description: rule is a final rule, proposed_rule a proposal open to comment, notice an agency notice, presidential_document an executive order or proclamation.

query.description: Words to find in Federal Register documents, for example 'noncompete' or 'PFAS drinking water'.

name: search_federal_register
title: Search the Federal Register and rulemakings
